patch_description: Instead of a single greedy pass, this approach uses a feasibility-driven strategy: it binary-searches a target KVPR threshold λ, then uses a first-fit-decreasing packing (models sorted by density r/s descending) to check if all models can be assigned to GPUs such that each GPU stays under λ while fitting memory. This produces a much more balanced placement than greedy, since the threshold forces spreading of pressure rather than piling onto the currently-least-loaded GPU. After finding the minimal feasible λ, one refinement pass moves models between GPUs if it lowers the max KVPR. This yields lower max KVPR at negligible runtime cost.
